answer: The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Trying costs a deposit of 26 credits, frozen until 21 days after the grading closes a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. No Exalted lock maker field bond, no seat: the rule is plain, and a bond makers lodge after tumbler checks is why it holds. The garden is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps jade. The spiral is on the docket.
